subject: EU territory screening: SOC 2 / HIPAA status + ITAR/OFAC checklist
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bishop <sara.bishop@nexahealth.com>, Seth Parker <seth.parker@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: EU territory screening - quick recap + asks

Hi Sara / Seth —

Thanks again for taking time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and three quick asks so your security & legal folks can get started: 

Recap:
- NexaHealth is evaluating Redwood for multi-tenant inference on non-PHI telemetry and an upcoming HIPAA-scoped pilot for de-identified PHI processing in the EU.
- Primary concerns: data residency in EU regions, SOC 2 evidence and attestation date, and export-control screening (ITAR/OFAC) for model weights and inference artifacts.
- Nexa’s legal asked whether we can guarantee EU-only hosting for the pilot and what controls we provide for cross-border transfers and vendor access.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you share any vendor security questionnaire you want us to complete? We’ll prioritise it — we can return a draft within 48 hours once we have it.
2) Please confirm whether the pilot will involve PHI as defined by US HIPAA or only de-identified data per your internal classification. That affects which artefacts we can provide.
3) We’ll need contact for OFAC/Export screening — if Andrew (copied below) or your compliance ops team can share any export control form or prior vendor-screening answers that speeds validation.

Attachments I’ll send to your security mailbox once we have the questionnaire: SOC 2 report, short data residency FAQ, and a proposed mutual action plan template.

Proposed times for an evidence-review call (30 min): Mon 4/19 09:00–10:30 CEST or Tue 4/20 14:00–15:30 CEST. Which works?

Thanks — I’ll wait for the questionnaire and the pilot PHI confirmation and will slot the SOC 2 evidence review once we have your preferred time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

-----
From: Sara Bishop <sara.bishop@nexahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Seth Parker <seth.parker@nexahealth.com>, Andrew Green <andrew.green@lawfirm-evans.com>, eu-it-ops@nexahealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Follow-up: EU territory screening - quick recap + asks

Thanks Diego —

Appreciate the summary. A few quick answers from our side: 
- We will send our standard vendor security questionnaire (attached) — it’s the one our InfoSec team uses for cloud vendors. Expect it this afternoon.
- For the pilot: clinical ops wants to use de-identified PHI for model evaluation, but our privacy team may still require HIPAA mapping for controls. I’ll confirm if it’s formally in-scope by EOD Monday.
- Export controls: we run an internal OFAC/ITAR screen on vendors — I’ve looped in Andrew and eu-it-ops. We don’t expect ITAR to be an issue for the pilot, but if you can confirm model origin (open-source vs proprietary) and whether any model weights leave EU regions that helps.

We’ll attach the questionnaire as a Word doc. Can you confirm you’ll provide SOC 2 Type II for 2026 (redacted if needed) and any EU-region hosting docs up front?

Sara
Head of IT Security, NexaHealth
sara.bishop@nexahealth.com

[attachment: Nexa_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx (docx)]

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bishop <sara.bishop@nexahealth.com>, Seth Parker <seth.parker@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: EU territory screening - quick recap + asks

Hi Sara —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. Short answers to the two points: 
- SOC 2: we can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (2026) under an NDA / redaction as required. I’ll attach a redacted PDF and a cover note describing the scope (hosting, access controls, change management).
- EU hosting & residency: Redwood supports dedicated tenancy in the EU via our Dublin and Frankfurt regions. For your pilot we can provision EU-only compute and block egress to non-EU networks by default; cross-border movement is only permitted with an explicit routing policy and customer consent.

On HIPAA: if you confirm the pilot is de-identified then Redwood’s standard hosting controls typically cover the assessment, but we will map the SOC 2 control set to HIPAA Safeguards if you need a separate matrix.

I’ll attach: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf (redacted) and a short Data-Residency-FAQ.

Next proposed steps:
- Diego to complete Nexa questionnaire (48h turnaround)
- Evidence review call: Tue 4/20 14:00–14:30 CEST (proposed) — Diego to send calendar invite
- Andrew / Nexa legal to confirm any additional export-control evidence required

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[attachment: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: Data-Residency-FAQ.pdf (pdf)]

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: EU territory screening - quick recap + asks

Great — thanks everyone. Action items and owners below (I’ll also push into HubSpot):

Action items:
- Diego: complete Nexa_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx and return with attachments (SOC2 redacted + Data Residency FAQ) — target: Tue 4/20 08:00 CEST.
- Marissa: provide SOC 2 redaction guidance and the redacted PDF (done).
- Nexa (Sara / Andrew): confirm whether pilot data is formally in-scope for HIPAA by Mon 4/19 EOD.
- Nexa (eu-it-ops): provide any export-control checklist / prior vendor screens; if possible share previous OFAC screening output.

Evidence & links I uploaded for your review: 
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4D_Nexa_Questionnaires
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/NEXA-9876

If we get confirmation that the data is de-identified and you confirm 4/20 14:00 CEST for the evidence call, I’ll send the invite and include a short runbook for the SOC2 artifacts review.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Nexa_Security_Questionnaire_v1_completed.docx (docx) — to be delivered in reply]
